source_revision: Blackbox signed generic event envelope v1 (packages/application/src/connectors/generic.ts; payload schemas packages/contracts/src/journal.ts)
identity_rule: provider identity scoped by connection/account namespace: dedup_key = <namespace>:<provider event id>; entity refs are tenant-scoped; no join by email or bare order number
coverage_rule: coverage.observed per capability after a fully paginated/imported run; answers compare required datasets against coverage facts and return partial/insufficient_data otherwise

event_rules.rule: crates/domain/src/derive.rs r1: refund.pending -> facts plus commitments/movements/reservations as defined for this family; derived entries carry input_entry_ids and dedup key derived:<entry>:r1:<n>

crates/domain/src/derive.rs r1: refund.completed -> facts plus commitments/movements/reservations as defined for this family; derived entries carry input_entry_ids and dedup key derived:<entry>:r1:<n>

synchronization.initial_import: plan-driven fixed UTC window, cursor pagination, per-page durable commit (shopify); single envelope/import (generic, bank_csv); on-write (policy, runtime, replay)
synchronization.reconciliation: daily reconciliation of the last 48 h for polling capabilities; re-import for files; n/a for internal producers
synchronization.deduplication: journal_append rejects identical provider identity (inserted=false) and raises BBX02 for different content (review case)
synchronization.freshness: last_successful_sync_at (complete empty checks allowed) distinct from last_new_record_at; delayed after 3x poll interval

local_standalone.schedule: producer-driven; no schedule; recovery = re-send with the same idempotency key (deduplicated)
local_standalone.recovery: durable per-page commit before checkpoint advance; restart resumes cursors; duplicates deduplicated by provider identity
local_standalone.limitations: no webhooks (outbound only); intermediate provider states between polls are not observed

local_gateway.reason: deferred by delivery-profile.json (no gateway is provisioned in the pilot)

public_server.reason: deferred by delivery-profile.json (no public server profile in the pilot)

import_readiness.historical_availability: declared_coverage from the producer is recorded as a labelled assertion
import_readiness.open_and_related_records: producer responsibility; links are explicit ids
import_readiness.opening_state: inventory.snapshot and provider.balance_observed are snapshots, not movements
import_readiness.readiness_rules: coverage.observed only when the producer declares it; otherwise partial
import_readiness.health_rules: authenticated push: no scheduled poll; last received and last new record tracked
import_readiness.history_expansion: producer re-sends; idempotency per event id
import_readiness.data_handling: payloads validated against allowlisted schemas; unknown keys rejected
